title: AI Game Jam
author: dgeisert
selftext:
The last regular game jam that I liked, Mini Jam, has finally forbidden AI use.  So I've decided to setup a new regular game jam: 

# [Jamference  ](https://itch.io/jam/jamference-ai-game-jam-hack-1)

This will require some use of AI to participate, and there will be mutual rating and reviewing afterwards.  

I'll run it every other week, so there is one week for making a game and one week for playing each others games.  You don't need to spend a full week making a game, a game that was a single prompt is fine to submit.

It is best if the games are web playable, as that makes it much easier to play each others games quickly and easily and not have to worry about mac or pc.

I look forward to playing all your games!  For this first one I'm making it a bit more time to get signups before starting the every other week cadence.  I'll also commit to playing all the submissions and streaming the playthroughs.
